name: Werewolf
summary: A race you catch, not choose: a scratch, a 5% chance, and the next full moon.
blood: No blood meter. Hunger is fed by eating the bodies of the dead with the devour action.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.effect: Eat a body lying on the ground to sate your hunger.

strengths: The strongest werewolf on the server wears the **Alpha** tag: a 20% buff
Stays in full wolf form with the [[werewolf-ring]]

clan.name: Pack
clan.body: Werewolves run in packs, as vampires keep bloodlines and witches covens.

sections.heading: Forms
sections.body: A werewolf has a normal player form and a full wolf form. The [[werewolf-ring]] keeps you in full wolf form for good.

sections.heading: 15 October 2026
sections.body:
- The Alpha tag (+20%) for the strongest werewolf on the server
- More than 20 new werewolf skins
- Every werewolf attack poisons vampires
- Howl summons other werewolves
- Shorter cooldowns, and fatal attacks
